_comment: Few things, thinly: what grows thinned out, what stands set far apart, every part leaning barren and scattered
and away from the lush. `open` is the shape of the land and the sky; this is how little is on it.
Before the creatures and the stars it is `few`'s: half as many. Before the structures it will set them apart.
Said of tunnels, a lattice, fissures or chambers, about half as many of them.
